properties.Long Description:
Target Hunt Action drops you straight into fast-paced shooting challenges where every tap matters. Load up, take aim, and blast through waves of moving, spinning, and surprise targets in this addictive offline action game.

Each level gives you a clear goal: hit the required number of targets before you run out of time or ammo. Tap to shoot, drag to aim, and watch targets shatter with satisfying effects. From simple bullseyes to tricky moving objects and hidden targets, every stage tests your focus, timing, and precision.

As you progress, unlock new shooting ranges, tougher patterns, and special target types that require smart shots and quick reactions. Earn rewards for clean combos and perfect rounds, then use them to upgrade your gear with stronger weapons, faster reloads, and cooler visual effects.

Whether you have a minute or an hour, Target Hunt Action is built for quick, fun sessions and endless replay. Fans of casual shooters, target practice games, and arcade action will enjoy climbing through levels, chasing high scores, and mastering every range.

Ready to prove your aim? Grab your virtual weapon, line up the shot, and start your target hunt today.
properties.Product Features:
🎯 Precision Shooting — Tap to aim and shoot at targets with simple, responsive controls
🔫 Varied Targets — Hit moving, spinning, and surprise targets that keep every level fresh
⏱️ Time & Ammo Challenges — Beat the clock and manage your shots to clear each stage
📈 Progressive Difficulty — Start easy and advance to tougher patterns and faster targets
🏅 Rewards & Upgrades — Earn coins to improve your weapons and unlock new ranges
📱 Perfect for Short Sessions — Quick action levels ideal for casual play and offline fun
